text:
Anika Patel: Quick heads-up — Solaris lab is ready to run our first thermal + power probe for the alpha HW this week. Need to confirm NDA scope for telemetry and agree a 4-hour priority queue window.
Samir Rao: thanks. do we have serials + firmware pinned? thermal runs depend a lot on fw.
Anika Patel: Partner sent a CSV with 6 units and fw v1.2.3; I uploaded to the shared drive: https://rwd.team/solar-lab-csv (internal).
Jordan Li: what's our KPI here? are we collecting sustained perf at p99 or peak stable over 10m?
Anika Patel: primary KPIs: p50/p95/p99 latency at 2k token window, tokens/sec throughput, and power draw (W) every 10s. Also thermal throttling events.
Samir Rao: ok. test plan: run 3x 30m steady-state profiles, then a 20m stress with long-context. Need boot args and kernel dmesg capture.
Maya Chen: legal note — before any telemetry leaves Solaris lab we need NDAs confirmed for raw logs and IP redaction rules. Can Solaris mark logs as "partner-telemetry" and we set retention 90 days?
Anika Patel: I'll confirm with Solaris today. they asked if we can use presigned S3 PUTs to upload encrypted tarballs.
Samir Rao: presigned PUTs are fine. Jordan/infra: we'll need a small script for upload and a verification webhook. example curl for presigned PUT:
```bash
curl -X PUT "${PRESIGNED_URL}" -H "x-amz-meta-source:solaris-alpha" --upload-file ./probe.tar.gz
```
Jordan Li: can implement. benchbot, can you queue a dedicated run slot and tag it SOLARIS-ALPHA?
benchbot: Run slot reserved — queue id 5598, slot window 2025-08-15 02:00-06:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
Samir Rao: perfect. also need to capture ambient temp, chassistemp sensor output, and a periodic `nvidia-smi --query` style dump (or equivalent).
Anika Patel: Solaris provided a telemetry schema (JSON) and device mappings. I'll attach to the drive.
Jordan Li: for benchmarking, let's include a small synthetic workload and one real-model workload (gpt-compat 1B). please make sure model seed and prompts are versioned.
Maya Chen: NDA confirmation: Solaris legal contacts listed as legal@solaris.co; I need the signed agreement before we accept raw logs. partner agreed to data redaction + 90d retention.
Anika Patel: noted. action items: 1) Maya to confirm NDA signature (ETA EOD) 2) Samir to post run checklist + required FW/hw pins 3) Jordan to land presigned upload + verification webhook 4) benchbot reserved slot 5598.
Leo Gomez: thanks team — can we have a quick 15m sync once NDA is signed to align ops & eng? propose 2025-08-14 18:00 UTC.
Samir Rao: 18:00 works for me.
Jordan Li: fine. I'll prep the upload script and a small README for the lab techs.
Maya Chen: I'll ping Solaris legal now.
Anika Patel: great — I'll update the drive with final checklists and post a summary in this thread when NDA is in place. :thumbsup:
